docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

docs.title: Minimum Hardware Requirements
docs.text:
• CPU: 4 vCPU
  • RAM: 8 GB
  • Disk Space: 20 GB free
  • Notes: Tested and verified for stability and acceptable performance.

docs.title: Additional Requirements
docs.text:
• Runtime: .NET Runtime, WebView2 Runtime
  • Network: Stable internet connection
  • VM Support: Works on virtual machines meeting above specs
